priorityList: Use Tiger's Fury on cooldown for energy and damage, ideally when Frantic Frenzy is available or energy is low.
Cast Berserk (or Incarnation: Avatar of Ashamane) whenever Tiger's Fury is active.
Cast Feral Frenzy (or Frantic Frenzy) if you have 2 or fewer Combo Points.
Cast Convoke the Spirits while Tiger's Fury is active, preferably after a Rip or Ferocious Bite.
Cast Ferocious Bite immediately if Apex Predator's Craving procs.
Cast Ferocious Bite (Ravage) if the Chomp/Ravage enabler is active.
At 5 Combo Points, cast Rip if it is missing or has less than 7 seconds remaining.
At 5 Combo Points, cast Ferocious Bite if Rip is already active and you are at high energy (50+).
Use Shadowmeld to cast an empowered Rake if the current Rake is refreshable or weak.
Maintain Rake on the target, refreshing it if it has less than 4 seconds remaining or if Tiger's Fury is active to snapshot the buff.
Maintain Moonfire (if talented) as a builder to keep the damage over time active.
Use Shred as your primary builder to reach 5 Combo Points when other bleeds are applied.
Use Regrowth with Predatory Swiftness procs to manage healing or maintain Bloodtalons (if talented).
Align on-use damage trinkets with your Tiger's Fury or Berserk windows.
If in Prowl, open with Rake to apply an empowered bleed.
